stemMd: Let $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\3&0\end{pmatrix}$ and $b=\begin{pmatrix}4\\-1\end{pmatrix}$. What is the column vector $Ab$?
explanationMd: The first component is 1 times 4 plus 2 times −1, giving 2. The second is 3 times 4 plus 0 times −1, giving 12.

distractorRationale.a: This reverses the order of the two row results.
distractorRationale.b: The first dot product subtracts two because the second component of b is negative.
distractorRationale.c: This multiplies only individual entries, not full row-column products.
